therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: mTOR inhibition combined with estrogen receptor degradation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: inhibition of PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway and estrogen signaling in hormone-resistant breast cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: advanced/metastatic breast cancer patients after aromatase inhibitor failure

results.dose_information: Everolimus 10 mg daily (two 5 mg tablets); Fulvestrant 500 mg IM on day 1 in two divided doses, then 250 mg on day 14, then 250 mg on day 28 and every 4 weeks thereafter
